mapper.sql: c.id, c.name, c.room, c.begin_date, c.end_date, c.master_id, c.subject, c.create_time, c.update_time, e.name as masterName, (case when c.begin_date > now() then '未开班' when now() > c.end_date then '已结课' else '在读中' end) as status
mapper.select:
select from clazz c left join emp e on c.master_id = e.id
c.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and c.end_date between #{begin} and #{end}

mapper.insert: insert into clazz(name, room, begin_date, end_date, master_id, subject, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{room}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{masterId}, #{subject}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select c.name as name, count(s.id) as value from clazz c left join student s on s.clazz_id = c.id group by c.id, c.name order by c.id
